topic: Figure 04 Sealed Publication Figure & Multi-Corpus Statistical Audit
headline: Population spiking primarily represents temporal sequence state, rather than the identity of an expected-but-omitted stimulus.

inferential_audit.temporal_context_fdr: Mean balanced accuracy = 0.3743 +/- 0.0101 (Chance = 0.2500); exactly 43/79 (54.4%) area populations survive strict Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction at q_fdr < 0.05.
inferential_audit.stimulus_subspace: PCA-5 preserved the measured held-out stimulus-decoding performance of the ambient representation (0.8303 vs 0.8270).
inferential_audit.omission_identity: Omission identity was not detectably represented in scalar firing rates, spatiotemporal linear subspaces, or the tested low-dimensional nonlinear population manifolds.
inferential_audit.terminal_structure: Terminal slot p4 reflects terminal-position-specific structure (cross-position transfer collapses to 0.3870, 0/77 significant).
inferential_audit.trajectory_dynamics: No transient identity divergence exceeding the within-cycle permutation null was detected at the tested 53-ms resolution.

sampling_scope.full_corpus: N=22 sessions, n=79 area populations (Panels B, C, D, E)
sampling_scope.representative_manifold_subset: N=4 multi-area sessions across all 3 subjects (sub-C31o_ses-230816, sub-C31o_ses-230823, sub-V182o_ses-260710, sub-V198o_ses-230719; n=960 decoding runs; Panels A, F, G, H, I)
